document_annotation.summary: This document introduces Mistral 7B, a 7-billion-parameter language model designed for high performance and efficiency. The model leverages grouped-query attention (GQA) and sliding window attention (SWA) to achieve faster inference and handle longer sequences with reduced computational cost. Mistral 7B outperforms the best open 13B model (Llama 2) across all evaluated benchmarks and surpasses the best released 34B model (Llama 1) in reasoning, mathematics, and code generation. A fine-tuned instruction-following variant, Mistral 7B – Instruct, also demonstrates superior performance compared to Llama 2 13B – Chat. The model is released under the Apache 2.0 license, with accompanying code and deployment tools for accessibility and ease of integration.
